title: WHO recommends social network-based HIV testing approaches for key populations as part of partner services package: policy brief

sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: The cover of the English November 2019 WHO policy brief recommending social network-based HIV testing for key populations as part of partner services.

sections.extract: WHO RECOMMENDS SOCIAL NETWORK- BASED HIV TESTING APPROACHES FOR KEY POPULATIONS AS PART OF PARTNER SERVICES PACKAGE NOVEMBER 2019 POLICY BRIEF

sections.title: Page 2

summary.text: Explains that WHO recommends voluntary testing for the sexual and drug-injecting partners of people with HIV, but that key populations often fear stigma and breaches of confidentiality when naming partners. It defines social network-based testing, summarises review findings on its benefits and safety, and states the new recommendation.

sections.extract: WHO recommends social network-based HIV testing approaches for key populations as part of partner services package The World Health Organization (WHO) recommends voluntary HIV testing services (HTS) for sexual and drug- injecting partners of all people with HIV. An effective approach is provider-assisted referral when a trained provider offers voluntary HTS to partner(s) with the consent of HIV-positive client.

sections.title: Page 3

summary.text: Lists promising social network-based testing models and the operational principles of confidentiality, voluntariness and differentiated service choice. It gives LINKAGES project examples from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Haiti and Malawi showing high HIV-positive yields among tested contacts.

sections.extract: Several promising models for social network-based approaches have emerged that can be considered. These include: • use of peers to recruit key populations in their networks for HTS; • distribution of HIV self-testing kits by HIV-positive and HIV-negative clients to their partners and contacts; • use of new tools and technologies, such as digital and social media, text messaging and other web-based platforms, to

sections.title: Page 4

summary.text: Recommends offering partner services to newly diagnosed key population members at diagnosis and periodically, and weighing limited-wave versus ongoing network approaches. It addresses client safety and the need for monitoring indicators and reviewing programmes when harms occur, and includes WHO contact and licence details.

narratives.en: Photograph of three young men outdoors in front of a tiled-roof house; two are seated and one stands holding a wooden farm tool on his shoulder, and each looks at a small red-and-white card in his hands.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لثلاثة شبان في الهواء الطلق أمام منزل ذي سقف من القرميد؛ اثنان منهم جالسان والثالث واقف يحمل أداة زراعية خشبية على كتفه، وينظر كل منهم إلى بطاقة صغيرة باللونين الأحمر والأبيض في يديه.
narratives.zh: 照片：三名年轻男子在一座瓦顶房屋前的户外；两人坐着，一人站着，肩扛一件木制农具，每人都在看手中一张红白相间的小卡片。
narratives.es: Fotografía de tres hombres jóvenes al aire libre delante de una casa con tejado de tejas; dos están sentados y uno, de pie, lleva al hombro una herramienta agrícola de madera, y cada uno mira una pequeña tarjeta roja y blanca que tiene en las manos.
narratives.fr: Photographie de trois jeunes hommes en plein air devant une maison au toit de tuiles ; deux sont assis et un, debout, porte un outil agricole en bois sur l'épaule, et chacun regarde une petite carte rouge et blanche qu'il tient en main.
narratives.ru: Фотография трёх молодых мужчин на улице перед домом с черепичной крышей: двое сидят, один стоит с деревянным сельскохозяйственным орудием на плече, и каждый рассматривает небольшую красно-белую карточку в руках.
